title: Bronze dataset
description: A dataset as landed: at least one file, and an RO-Crate 1.3 crate recording its identifier, name, description, who uploaded it, when, its licence, its properties and the profiles it conforms to. Every dataset meets this profile, and others build on it with $ref. A profile checks the crate's root as frame.json lays it out, with what the root refers to embedded and additionalProperty keyed by name; $defs/properties checks the properties a publisher gives, as one flat record.

name.title: Name
name.description: What people call the dataset; the published folder's name unless --name gives another

description.title: Description
description.description: What the dataset holds; lbf writes one unless --description gives it
